newsitem.title: USA: Permanent Bancorp holders seek board seats.
newsitem.headline: Permanent Bancorp holders seek board seats.

text.p: A group of Michigan investors, including LaSalle Capital Management Inc, said Monday it expects to "actively assert shareholder rights" regarding its 5.7 percent or 121,000 share investment in Permanent Bancorp Inc.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said after meeting with the Evansville, Tenn. bank holding company's management, it still intends to seek two board seats.

"The group's purpose in seeking representatives on the board of directors is primarily to attempt to influence the board of directors to consider all possible strategic alternatives available," it said in the SEC filing.
One way of achieving this goal is to seek out another financial institution for a possible merger, the group said.

"The group is interested in influencing the issuer's board of directors to explore seriously, in consultation with independent financial advisors, this and other possible means of improving the market price of common stock," it said in the filing.
To stay in compliance with bank regulators, the group said it has no plans to acquire more than a 10 percent stake in Permanent Bancorp or to seek control of more than a third of the board.
Members of the investment group most recently acquired 29,500 shares in Permanent Bancorp between Feb. 24 and April 15 at $21 to $22.375 each.
